title: AutoDex: An Automated Real-World System for Dexterous Grasping Data Collection
abstract: arXiv:2606.23689v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling real-world dexterous-grasp data collection is limited by the sustained human effort required to operate the robot, verify grasp outcomes, and reset objects between trials. Simulation can generate grasp candidates at scale, but their success on hardware remains uncertain. We present AutoDex, a system that collects real-world dexterous-grasp data without continuous human operation. Given generated grasp candidates, AutoDex plans and executes grasps, labels their outcomes, and resets the object to continue collection across stable poses. Multi-view object tracking supports labeling under hand-object occlusion, while residual-torque collision monitoring and pose-directed reset enable the loop to operate without continuous human supervision. Using AutoDex, we collect over 3,500 grasp trials across 100 objects with Allegro and Inspire hands, recording both successes and failures together with synchronized visual observations

translated_title: AutoDex：一个用于灵巧抓取数据收集的自动化真实世界系统
translated_abstract: 真实世界灵巧抓取数据收集的规模化受到持续人工投入的限制，包括操作机器人、验证抓取结果以及在试验之间重置物体。仿真可以大规模生成抓取候选方案，但其在硬件上的成功率仍然不确定。我们提出了AutoDex，一个无需持续人工操作即可收集真实世界灵巧抓取数据的系统。给定生成的抓取候选方案，AutoDex规划并执行抓取、标注其结果，并重置物体以在稳定姿态间继续收集数据。多视角物体跟踪支持在手部与物体遮挡情况下的结果标注，而残余力矩碰撞监测和基于姿态的重置使该循环能够在没有持续人工监督的情况下运行。使用AutoDex，我们通过Allegro和Inspire灵巧手在100个物体上收集了超过3,500次抓取试验，同时记录了成功与失败的抓取数据以及同步的视觉观测。
tldr: AutoDex是一个无需持续人工监督的自动化真实世界灵巧抓取数据收集系统，通过多视角物体跟踪、残余力矩碰撞监测和姿态导向的自动重置，在100个物体上成功收集了超过3,500次包含成功与失败案例的抓取试验数据。
en_tdlr: AutoDex is an automated real-world system for collecting dexterous grasping data without continuous human supervision, leveraging multi-view object tracking, residual-torque collision monitoring, and pose-directed reset to gather over 3,500 grasp trials across 100 objects with both successes and failures recorded.
